component.name: Playground
component.summary: Make an app by describing it, then watch it come together

description.p: Playground is where you make things with an agent. Say what you want to make, answer a couple of questions, and Playground creates a real project folder, a one-page brief and a plan, then gets a first version on screen. You see and try the real thing as it is built, and every change arrives with proof that it works.

ul.li: Ari, Luma's own agent, or the Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and Goose programs you already use, each signed in through its own login
Goals with plain-language plans and checks, decisions only you can make, and a review before anything goes live
The live app side by side with your work in progress, on a phone, tablet or computer frame
Your own computer or your own servers, with short-lived certificates and an encrypted vault instead of passing keys around
Teammates who run the full app, see who is working where, and hand goals to each other

description.p: Everything lives in a folder you own, under Documents. Playground is fully open source and works locally.
